name: What Is Sin
overview: Sin, as revealed in Scripture, is the universal condition of falling short of God's glory, demonstrated by all humanity (Romans 3:23). It encompasses both wrongful actions like adultery and uncleanness (Galatians 5:19) and the failure to do what is known to be right (James 4:17). Sin's consequence is death, but through Jesus Christ, God offers the gift of eternal life (Romans 6:23). Furthermore, sin extends beyond overt acts to include anything done without faith (Romans 14:23), underscoring the necessity of trusting God in all things.
